headings.text: EINTRIKOT verbindet aktuelle und ehemalige Hockey-Nationalspielerinnen und Nationalspieler aller Generationen. Auf dem Platz. Und darüber hinaus.
Schon als Mitglied eines Jugendnationalteams gehörst du dazu. Gemeinsam wachsen und Verbindungen knüpfen.
Gemeinsame Spiele. Große Momente. Erfahrungen, die über Jahrgänge hinweg verbinden.
Die aktive Zeit endet. Die Verbindung bleibt. Wir halten sie lebendig.
Hier steht später ein echtes, freigegebenes Zitat.
Gleiche Funktionen, gleiche Wege. Jeder Bereich bekommt seine Farbe aus dem Brandbook.
Beitragsfrei. Ein Länderspiel in einem DHB-Nationalteam genügt, auch in der Jugend.

findings.message: 2 large-set statement(s) run past 3 lines at 1440px: "EINTRIKOT verbindet aktuelle und ehemali…" → 4 lines at 30px; "Schon als Mitglied eines Jugendnationalt…" → 4 lines at 30px
findings.fix: A statement set large is about 30 words. Cut it, or set the rest as ordinary body text.
Vary the composition; not every section is a card grid.

findings.message: Only 1 picture(s) on the page (0 photographs, footage or raster images, 1 interface fragments). Drawings in SVG do not count.
findings.fix: Find real pictures of the subject's world with scripts/assets.mjs (photographs, archival images, maps, engravings, footage), download them to assets/ and give them room: a hero picture, one per section that has a subject, a full-width band. At least four, usually six to twelve.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: The page sits off-centre: its content comes to 56px from the left edge but only to 131px from the right, at 1440px.
findings.fix: Give the page one pair of equal margins. Check the wrapper for a max-width without margin-inline: auto, a grid with an empty last column, or padding on one side only. If one side is meant to hold air, it must still be closed by something that reaches the margin (a picture, the navigation's last item, a figure).

findings.message: 33% of the first screen is one empty block (540×780px at 900,120).
findings.fix: Place the void on purpose or fill it: move the picture, the film or one fact into it, grow the headline to meet it, or shrink the screen to its content. A void reads as placed only when something closes it on the far side and it is the screen's one rest.

findings.message: 2 sections keep all their content on one side and leave 52% of the width empty: "Rein ins Trikot." (right 402px empty); "Im Trikot." (right 334px empty)
findings.fix: Use the whole width the page has set up: put the section's picture, its second column, its list or its figure in the empty half, or set the text larger across the grid. Empty space must be placed, with something on each side of it.

findings.message: The margins differ: 16px on the left, 0px on the right, at 390px.
findings.fix: Put the navigation and the content on one pair of margins; check for padding on one side only, a scrollbar gutter, or a header on another inset than the page.

findings.message: 1 text block(s) sit 12–15px from the phone's edge: "Wir verbinden Hockey-Nationals" (16px)
findings.fix: The page margin is 16–20px on a phone; the header and the corner labels sit on it too.
